8.
(1) The Commission shall function on full time basis.
(2) The meetings of the Commission shall be held at least
four times a month.
(3)  The  Chairman  shall  preside  at  all  meetings  of  the
Commission. In the absence of the Chairman at any meeting,
the members present shall elect a member from amongst the
members present, to preside at such meeting.
(4) The quorum for any meeting of the Commission shall
be five members. At least one member shall be a non-full
time member.
(5) The Chairman or in his absence the member presiding
at  any  meeting  shall  have,  in  addition  to  his  own  vote,  a
casting vote when there is an equality of votes.
(6)  The  votes  of  the  members  shall  be  recorded  in  the
minutes book of the Commission.
